name: blast-radius
description: Before a risky Bash command runs, says what it will touch. A plain deletion is judged by git: files outside git or tracked and clean get only a short label, a Ukrainian dialog (with the rm line, the number of files and a typed 'Other' decision) is for uncommitted changes, the home folder, more than 20 files and other hard risks. Static analysis plus read-only git, nothing is executed to preview.
